{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Dress: cocktail dress, fit-and-flare with a V-neck and three-quarter sleeves, midi length just below the knee, deep burgundy (#6D1F3A), matte crepe with a soft drape

Tights: sheer, plain, black (#1C1C1E), fine knit

Coat: single-breasted straight coat, knee length, camel (#B98B5E), wool blend

Shoes: closed-toe pumps with a mid block heel, black (#1B1B1B), smooth leather

Bag: small structured clutch with a slim chain strap, antique gold (#B08D57), textured leather

Earrings: small drop earrings with a single pearl, ivory (#F2EBDD), freshwater pearl with a gold-tone setting

Why it works: A burgundy cocktail dress with sleeves and a modest neckline is exactly the smart, celebratory level a family jubilee dinner in a restaurant calls for. It looks polished and festive without being flashy, so there is little for anyone to comment on. The midi length and the draped crepe are classic and respectful, and the pearls and gold clutch add a finished, thoughtful touch. The camel coat covers the autumn chill and keeps the whole look warm and put together on arrival."}
